places.name: Ceuta
places.significance: Spanish city on the Moroccan coast, facing Gibraltar across the strait
notes: A small landmass in Africa administered by another country — Spain

places.name: Gibraltar
places.significance: British Overseas Territory at the southern tip of Spain, across the strait from Ceuta
notes: A small landmass administered by another country — the United Kingdom

places.name: Sinai Peninsula
places.significance: Egypt's triangle of land in Asia, east of the Suez Canal
notes: The Suez Canal runs along its western edge

places.name: Suez Canal
places.significance: Links the Mediterranean to the Red Sea, cutting Sinai off from the rest of Egypt

places.name: Rabat
places.significance: Capital of Morocco, on the Atlantic coast

places.name: Casablanca
places.significance: Morocco's largest city, on the Atlantic

places.name: Marrakech
places.significance: The Red City, below the High Atlas

places.name: Tangier
places.significance: Major port on the Strait of Gibraltar

places.name: Alboran Sea
places.significance: Westernmost basin of the Mediterranean, off Morocco's north coast

places.name: Algiers
places.significance: Capital of Algeria, on the Mediterranean

places.name: Tunis
places.significance: Capital of Tunisia, on the Mediterranean

places.name: Tripoli
places.significance: Capital of Libya, on the Mediterranean

places.name: Benghazi

places.name: Gulf of Sidra

places.name: Asmara
